title: Optimization of a level bound
statement: Let $\alpha,W\in\mathbb R$, with $0<\alpha\le1$, and let $k$ be a positive natural number satisfying $k\le2\log(1/\alpha)$. Suppose that for every real $\rho$ with $0<\rho\le1$, $\rho^kW\le\alpha^{2/(1+\rho)}$. Then $W\le\left(\frac{2e}{k}\log(1/\alpha)\right)^k\alpha^2$.
replaced: Let $0<\alpha\le1$, $W\in\mathbb R$, and a positive integer $k$ satisfy $k\le2\log(1/\alpha)$. If $\rho^kW\le\alpha^{2/(1+\rho)}$ for every $0<\rho\le1$, then $W\le((2e/k)\log(1/\alpha))^k\alpha^2$.
